summary: Iteration 86 - Auto-crop feature verification. ALL 45 TESTS PASSED. The autoCrop() function in scanner.worker.js correctly implements Sobel edge detection with projection-based document boundary detection. File uploads pass autoCrop:false (no cropping), camera captures pass autoCrop:true (auto-crop enabled). Safety checks prevent cropping if result <30% or >95% of original. All existing features (filters, rotation, save, mode toggle, multi-page) continue working.
